name: How much does a custom kitchen renovation cost in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does a custom kitchen renovation cost in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a custom kitchen renovation in Orange County can range significantly, typically from $30,000 to over $100,000, depending on several factors. These include the size of your kitchen, the quality of materials chosen (e.g., custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, premium countertops), the extent of layout changes, and any structural modifications. A basic refresh with new cabinets and countertops will be at the lower end, while a complete custom redesign with luxury finishes will be at the higher end. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom kitchen renovation costs in Orange County generally range from $30,000 to $100,000+, depending on scope and materials.
